description: Webhook dispatcher daemon. Reads WEBHOOK_URLS from env var (comma-separated). Polls mesh_events every 60s for new severity=CRITICAL or WARNING events with event_type in (build_generation_failed,signal_drift_detected,new_threat_detected). For each: POST to each webhook URL with JSON {event_type,severity,payload,timestamp,source=zo_sentinel}. Retry 3x with 5s backoff. Log success/failure per webhook. Graceful degradation if no WEBHOOK_URLS set (logs warning and skips). Heartbeat.
